> Let $\delta > 0$. If $n$ is sufficiently large and $G$ is a graph on $n$ vertices with no $K_{2,2,2}$ (the octahedron) and at least $\delta n^2$ edges, must $G$ contain an independent set of size $\gg_\delta n$? This is a problem of Erdős, Hajnal, Sós, and Szemerédi [EHSS83]. It is **open**; they proved the statement for $\delta > 1/8$…
